item.name: 1.1 Admin login - valid (direct token or MFA challenge)

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.token; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.environment.set('admin_token', v); } catch (e) {}
try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.challenge_id; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.environment.set('challenge_id', v); } catch (e) {}
pm.test('token or mfa_required', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(!!(j.token || j.code === 'mfa_required')).to.be.true; });

request.description: Only needed when ADMIN_MFA_ENABLED=true. Set otp_code to the texted code. 422 accepted when MFA is off.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.token; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.environment.set('admin_token', v); } catch (e) {}
try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.token; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.environment.set('resident_token', v); } catch (e) {}
try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.challenge_id; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.environment.set('resident_challenge_id', v); } catch (e) {}
try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.token; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.environment.set('resident_token', v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Re-run 1.1/1.3 afterwards to get a fresh admin_token.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = (j.data || j)[0].service_id; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.environment.set('test_service_id', v); } catch (e) {}
